# Abmiti Flutter app

Flutter client for Abmiti's existing REST API. Authentication, summaries, transactions, categories, budgets, notifications, profile data, subscriptions, and checkout all use the backend contracts; no finance records or business rules are stored in a separate mobile data layer.

## API configuration & Physical Device Setup

The app dynamically resolves its API base URL via **`AppConfig`**, supporting compile-time flags, saved preferences, and in-app switching:

### Developing with a Physical Device

#### 1. Different Router / Isolated Network (USB cable) — Recommended
If your phone is on a different Wi-Fi router or mobile data while your PC is on Ethernet, connect your phone to the PC via USB with USB debugging enabled, then run:

```sh
# Setup port reverse (forwards phone localhost:5000 -> Ubuntu PC:5000)
./build.sh connect
# Or manually:
adb reverse tcp:5000 tcp:5000

# Run the app:
flutter run --dart-define=API_ENV=different_router
```

#### 2. Same Router / Local Wi-Fi (LAN IP)
If both the phone and Ubuntu PC are connected to the same Wi-Fi router / subnet:

```sh
flutter run --dart-define=API_ENV=same_router --dart-define=LAN_IP=192.168.26.65
```

#### 3. Production Server
```sh
flutter run --dart-define=API_ENV=production
```

#### 4. Custom Tunnel / URL (Cloudflare Tunnel, Localtunnel, Ngrok)
```sh
flutter run --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=https://your-subdomain.trycloudflare.com/api/v1
```

### In-App Runtime Switcher
You don't need to rebuild the app to change environments:
- On the **Login screen**, tap the **API chip** (or the URL at the bottom) to open the **API Environment & Network** modal.
- Once signed in, open the **Navigation Drawer** and tap **API Server**.
- Tap **Test Ping** to test live latency against the backend.
- Tap **Apply URL** to save to secure storage and switch immediately.

## Implemented API flows

- `POST /auth/login`, `POST /auth/register`, `POST /auth/refresh`, `GET /auth/me`, and `PATCH /auth/me`. Access and refresh tokens are kept in platform secure storage. The API client retries expired access tokens and signs out when refresh fails. Admin accounts are denied access to the personal finance screens.
- `GET /summary/monthly`, `GET /summary/categories`, `GET /summary/yearly`, `GET /summary/yearly-summary`, `GET /summary/budget-warnings`, `GET /entries`, `POST /entries`, `PATCH /entries/:id`, `DELETE /entries/:id`, and `GET /categories` power the overview, activity list, analytics, and transaction form. All six entry types (`income`, `expense`, `savings`, `investment`, `payable`, `receivable`) can be created and edited, with a date picker for back-dated entries.
- `GET /budgets`, `POST /budgets`, `PUT /budgets/:id`, `GET /budgets/:id/summary`, `POST /budgets/:id/lines`, `PUT /budgets/:id/lines/:lineId`, and `DELETE /budgets/:id/lines/:lineId` power the budget screen, including editing the estimated income and editing or removing allocation lines.
- `GET /categories`, `POST /categories`, `PATCH /categories/:id`, and `DELETE /categories/:id` power the categories manager with per-type tabs.
- `GET /notifications`, `PATCH /notifications/read-all`, and `PATCH /notifications/:id/read` power the in-app notification inbox and the unread badge in the app bar.
- `GET /subscriptions` shows server-reported plan history. `POST /payments/start` opens the backend-created SSLCommerz checkout URL. A plan is never marked paid by the app; the backend verifies the gateway callback/IPN.

The existing API has no password reset route, mobile-native Google OAuth callback, account deletion route, or notification pagination. Google OAuth still redirects to the web client. The mobile app does not simulate those flows or expose them as native actions. Subscription checkout and reporting require the server's SSLCommerz configuration.

/// Single source of truth for the Mobile API backend base URL.
///
/// Simply change [defaultBaseUrl] here if needed before building or running.
/// Or supply at runtime: `--dart-define=API_BASE_URL=https://...`
class AppConfig with ChangeNotifier {
  AppConfig([FlutterSecureStorage? _]);

  /// ── MANUALLY CONFIGURE BACKEND URL HERE ──────────────────────────────
  /// Change this string anytime before building or testing:
  /// - Production (live cPanel backend):
  ///   'https://robin.adovasoft.com/abmiti-app/api/v1'
  /// - Local development (via adb reverse / localhost):
  ///   'http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/v1'
  static const String defaultBaseUrl =
      'https://robin.adovasoft.com/abmiti-app/api/v1';
  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  // Compile-time override: flutter run --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=...
  static const String _definedBaseUrl = String.fromEnvironment('API_BASE_URL');

  String _currentBaseUrl = defaultBaseUrl;

  String get currentBaseUrl => _currentBaseUrl;

  Future<void> initialize() async {
    if (_definedBaseUrl.isNotEmpty) {
      _currentBaseUrl = normalizeUrl(_definedBaseUrl);
    } else {
      _currentBaseUrl = normalizeUrl(defaultBaseUrl);
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Ensure URL has no trailing slashes.
  static String normalizeUrl(String url) =>
      url.replaceAll(RegExp(r'/+$'), '');
}

import express from 'express';
import helmet from 'helmet';
import cors from 'cors';
import compression from 'compression';
import mongoSanitize from 'express-mongo-sanitize';
import morgan from 'morgan';

import { env } from './config/env';
import { logger } from './config/logger';
import { globalErrorHandler } from './shared/middleware/errorHandler';
import { rateLimiter } from './shared/middleware/rateLimiter';
import { notFoundHandler } from './shared/middleware/notFoundHandler';
import { registerRoutes } from './routes';

// DB connections
import { connectMongoDB } from './infrastructure/database/mongodb/connection';
import { connectMySQL }   from './infrastructure/database/mysql/connection';

const app = express();

/** Flutter Web assigns a different localhost port on each debug run. */
const isLocalDevelopmentOrigin = (origin: string): boolean => {
  try {
    const url = new URL(origin);
    return url.protocol === 'http:' &&
      (url.hostname === 'localhost' ||
        url.hostname === '127.0.0.1' ||
        url.hostname === '[::1]');
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
};

// ── Security middleware ──────────────────────────────────────
app.use(
  helmet({
    // Allow uploaded images/assets to be embedded cross-origin
    // (page served on :5173, static files on :5000 in dev).
    crossOriginResourcePolicy: { policy: 'cross-origin' },
  }),
);
app.use(
  cors({
    origin: (origin, callback) => {
      // Allow requests with no Origin header:
      // - Server-to-server / curl requests
      // - Phusion Passenger / Apache internal proxy (strips Origin)
      // - Same-origin requests from the SPA hosted on the same domain
      if (!origin) return callback(null, true);
      // Flutter Web uses an ephemeral localhost port in development.
      if (env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && isLocalDevelopmentOrigin(origin)) {
        return callback(null, true);
      }
      if (env.CLIENT_URLS.includes(origin)) return callback(null, true);
      callback(new Error(`CORS: origin "${origin}" is not allowed`));
    },
    credentials: true,
  }),
);
if (env.DB_PROVIDER === 'mongodb') {
  app.use(mongoSanitize());
}

// ── General middleware ───────────────────────────────────────
app.use(compression());
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10kb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));
import path from 'path';
app.use('/public', express.static(path.join(process.cwd(), 'public')));

if (env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
  app.use(morgan('dev'));
}

// ── Rate limiting ────────────────────────────────────────────
app.use(env.API_PREFIX, rateLimiter);

// ── Routes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
registerRoutes(app);

// ── Error handling ───────────────────────────────────────────
app.use(notFoundHandler);
app.use(globalErrorHandler);

// ── Bootstrap ───────────────────────────────────────────────
const start = async (): Promise<void> => {
  logger.info(`🗄️  DB provider: ${env.DB_PROVIDER}`);

  if (env.DB_PROVIDER === 'mysql') {
    await connectMySQL();
  } else {
    await connectMongoDB();
  }

  app.listen(env.PORT, () => {
    logger.info(`🚀 abmiti server running on port ${env.PORT} [${env.NODE_ENV}]`);
  });
};

start().catch((err) => {
  logger.error('Failed to start server', err);
  process.exit(1);
});

export default app;

# =============================================================================
# Abmiti Flutter App — Setup & Build Script

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

# ─── Colour output ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
RED='\033[0;31m'; GREEN='\033[0;32m'; YELLOW='\033[1;33m'; NC='\033[0m'
info()    { echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $*"; }
warning() { echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $*"; }
error()   { echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $*" >&2; }

# ─── Prerequisite checks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
check_prerequisites() {
    info "Checking prerequisites..."

    if ! command -v flutter &>/dev/null; then
        error "Flutter not found. Install Flutter 3.44.4-stable and ensure it's in PATH."
        exit 1
    fi

    local flutter_version
    flutter_version=$(flutter --version 2>&1 | head -1)
    info "Flutter: $flutter_version"

    if ! command -v java &>/dev/null; then
        error "Java not found. Install OpenJDK 21."
        exit 1
    fi

    local java_version
    java_version=$(java -version 2>&1 | head -1)
    info "Java: $java_version"

    # Create local.properties if missing
    if [[ ! -f "android/local.properties" ]]; then
        local flutter_sdk
        flutter_sdk=$(which flutter | xargs -I{} dirname {} | xargs -I{} dirname {})
        local android_home="${ANDROID_HOME:-${HOME}/Android/Sdk}"

        info "Creating android/local.properties..."
        cat > android/local.properties <<EOF
sdk.dir=${android_home}
flutter.sdk=${flutter_sdk}
flutter.buildMode=debug
flutter.versionName=1.0.0
flutter.versionCode=1
EOF
        info "local.properties created. Verify sdk.dir and flutter.sdk paths."
    fi
}

# ─── Commands ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cmd_setup() {
    check_prerequisites
    info "Installing Flutter dependencies..."
    flutter pub get

    info "Generating native splash screen..."
    dart run flutter_native_splash:create

    info "Generating app icons..."
    dart run flutter_launcher_icons

    info "Running flutter analyze..."
    flutter analyze

    info "✅ Setup complete! Run './build.sh debug' to build the debug APK."
}

cmd_debug() {
    check_prerequisites
    info "Building debug APK..."
    flutter build apk --debug --verbose
    info "✅ Debug APK: build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk"
}

cmd_release() {
    check_prerequisites
    info "Building release APK..."
    flutter build apk --release
    info "✅ Release APK: build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk"
}

cmd_analyze() {
    flutter analyze
}

cmd_clean() {
    info "Cleaning build artifacts..."
    flutter clean
    info "✅ Clean complete."
}

cmd_connect() {
    ./scripts/dev_connect.sh
}

# ─── Entry point ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
case "${1:-help}" in
    setup)   cmd_setup ;;
    debug)   cmd_debug ;;
    release) cmd_release ;;
    analyze) cmd_analyze ;;
    clean)   cmd_clean ;;
    connect) cmd_connect ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 {setup|debug|release|analyze|clean|connect}"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

import axios from 'axios';
import { useAuthStore } from '@/store/authStore';

export const apiClient = axios.create({
  baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:5000/api/v1',
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  timeout: 15_000,
});

// Attach access token
apiClient.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
  const token = useAuthStore.getState().accessToken;
  if (token) config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  return config;
});

// Handle 401 — attempt refresh
let refreshing = false;
let queue: Array<(token: string) => void> = [];

apiClient.interceptors.response.use(
  (res) => res,
  async (error) => {
    const original = error.config;
    if (error.response?.status !== 401 || original._retry) {
      return Promise.reject(error);
    }
    original._retry = true;

    if (refreshing) {
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        queue.push((token) => {
          original.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
          resolve(apiClient(original));
        });
      });
    }

    refreshing = true;
    try {
      const { refreshToken, setTokens, logout } = useAuthStore.getState();
      if (!refreshToken) { logout(); return Promise.reject(error); }

      const { data } = await axios.post(`${apiClient.defaults.baseURL}/auth/refresh`, { refreshToken });
      const { accessToken: newAccess, refreshToken: newRefresh } = data.data;
      setTokens(newAccess, newRefresh);

      queue.forEach((cb) => cb(newAccess));
      queue = [];

      original.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${newAccess}`;
      return apiClient(original);
    } catch {
      useAuthStore.getState().logout();
      return Promise.reject(error);
    } finally {
      refreshing = false;
    }
  },
);
